title: After just two weeks of development time, Tiny RTS is now live and playable! A browser RTS with real-time multiplayer, community maps, and instant play. No download or install required. Only possible throught LOTS of AI assisted coding via Claude Opus 4.6 and Codex 5.3!

replies.author: MagusCurt
replies.body:
Assets seems to be by Pixel Frog, hand (mouse?) drawn.

But I'm wondering your first question too. I use Godot, and as far as I know, AI can't help much with organizing and connecting nodes in a way to work correctly. If there's a way to speed that process up too, I'd be extremely interested. Especially with UI development.

replies.author: anewidentity
replies.body: Yeah, i’ve resorted to typescript and Pixijs. I feel like for AI dev it works better than other engines

replies.author: Ukatyushas
replies.body:
I used godot-mcp in claude code and the agent can manipulate nodes, run godot, and read the debug output.

But I found it annoying to have an external dependency so I had claude migrate all functionality of godot-mcp it to a skill with specific instructions for my system and game eg. hardcoded commands for running godot. So far its working well.

I saw your games, thanks a lot for playing it and for the feedback! I agree on it needing a bit more depth. Theres lot of things planned. Im trying to implement most things from the asset pack this is based on: https://pixelfrog-assets.itch.io/tiny-swords
